notes: CAIRN 0.7c - PRE-RELEASE (alpha). Rename-era cleanup is complete: the last legacy env fallbacks (MARA_HOME, MARA_REGISTRY, MARA_HOST, MARA_PORT) are GONE - CAIRN_* env names are the only spellings, and the update smoke harness now passes CAIRN_* only. Upgrade note: automatic update to 0.7c works from 0.7b or newer (the 0.7b harness speaks both spellings); a pre-0.7b build cannot auto-stage this release - its smoke check fails closed, live files untouched - so upgrade manually per INSTALL.md after taking a backup. This build is ALPHA: auto-update remains owner-confirmed, databases are never auto-restored, and pre-release builds may break. Crossers from 0.6x: run the migration ferry (cairn-migrate.py, --dry-run first) BEFORE updating. Nonce 20.
